required_findings.criteria: Identifies that the touch listener has no equivalent accessibility action or standard click behavior.
Identifies that the custom-drawn control does not expose its role, current value, and supported action through accessibility nodes.
Recommends an appropriate custom View accessibility node contract or replacement with a standard control rather than contentDescription alone.
Requires TalkBack and Voice Access verification of discovery, action, and state updates on a device.

forbidden_claims: Claims drawing text creates accessible semantics
Treats a contentDescription alone as a complete fix
